source: 시안 — 저장소를 만들기 전(2026-10-30) 손으로 쓴 지시문. 설계표(traits·worlds)의 바탕이 됐다. 일상컷 자리(casual1)는 현대 세계 시안 — 일상컷 트리가 붙기 전이라 트리 기록이 없다
prompt:
CONCEPT: a citizen of the Hydrogen Nation — the nation of the lightest element: airy, pale, luminous, always rising. Each citizen is a personification of one substance or use of that element.
CITIZEN: WATER BOTTLE (present day). A female personification character with a clear glass bottle of pure drinking water as her motif — the bottle reimagined as a woman in cloth and ornament that carry its materials, colors, shape and motifs: transparent and translucent layers like glass, a cylindrical silhouette, a cap-shaped hat or hair ornament, water-blue and clear highlights, condensation droplets as beads, a faint H2O-like pairing of two small pale spheres and one blue sphere as a brooch. She does NOT hold the bottle; it is not a separate object. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ERA: PRESENT DAY, 2026. A real modern city riverside on a bright morning — glass office towers, a jogging path, a hydrogen bus passing in the distance. Her outfit is contemporary everyday fashion (a light sporty dress or athleisure) built from the bottle's materials and colors; nothing fantasy, nothing sci-fi.
STYLE: Polished 2.5D game key art with clean linework, controlled anime facial design, layered cel-to-soft shading and crisp costume and prop detail. Use a vivid, readable silhouette and campaign-quality lighting.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
